name: post-card
description: Post preview card with feature image, primary tag, excerpt, and reading time.

files.name: post-card.hbs
files.content:
{{!-- Component: Post Card Usage: Inside {{#foreach posts}} ... {{> "components/post-card"}} ... {{/foreach}} --}}
{{#if feature_image}} {{/if}}
{{#if primary_tag}} {{primary_tag.name}} • {{/if}} {{reading_time}}

{{title}}

{{#if excerpt}}

{{excerpt words="25"}}

{{/if}}
{{#primary_author}} {{name}} {{/primary_author}}
{{date format="D MMM YYYY"}}

files.name: post-card.css

gscan.notes: Uses standard Ghost post helpers (feature_image, primary_tag, reading_time, excerpt, date).
